configuration.setup: Official 7.3.77 Debian packages extracted into ignored target; no system installation. Single-process single-redundancy test cluster, not HA evidence.

fdb.scope: storage/runtime contract only; application integration and unknown-response recovery are later gates

redb.concurrent_schedule_scope: serialized writers; concurrent controls supplied separately
redb.scope: storage/runtime contract only; application integration and unknown-response recovery are later gates

surreal.scope: storage/runtime contract only; application integration and unknown-response recovery are later gates

corrections: Docker layer registration failed for space; extracted official release packages instead. Upgraded initial 7.3.69 runtime to verified stable Latest 7.3.77 before accepted probe.
FoundationDB 0.11 required compatible serde_json and uuid updates; existing exact pins prevented dependency resolution.
Initial FDB namespace incorrectly entered reserved 0xff system range; corrected to user keyspace and reran real controls.
Compiler caught published SurrealKV API differences; corrected imports and range arity.
Added validated Surreal point reads, 256 conservative range-guard buckets, and persistent runtime/explicit close; no per-commit threads.
limitations: Surreal guard bucket collisions can cause conservative false conflicts.
redb concurrency is serialized; the raw optimistic overlap schedules are not executed for redb.
No application receipt/replay or response-loss assertion is claimed by this probe.
FoundationDB limits remain default; no throughput or full-production claim.
scope: Raw storage/runtime contract only. Application Store integration, metadata/cursor coordination, API workflow recovery and G7 closeout remain unaccepted.
